subject: Transportation Systems
title: Adaptive Traffic Signals
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Adaptive Traffic Signals.

hook.text: Most traffic lights run on fixed timers set decades ago. They don't know if the road is empty or jammed.

buildup.text: Adaptive signals use sensors and cameras to detect real-time traffic and adjust green times dynamically.

discovery.text: Pittsburgh's adaptive system reduced travel time by 25% and emissions by 21% on equipped corridors.

twist.text: Installing and maintaining smart signals costs millions. Many cities can't afford to upgrade.

climax.text: Connected vehicles could eventually communicate directly with signals. The light knows you're coming.

punchline.text: A traffic light that watches the road wastes less of everyone's time.

quiz.question: How much did Pittsburgh's adaptive signals reduce travel time?
